name: fleet-image
description: What the session image carries, which `fleet-setup image` installs at /opt/fleet-box: fleet-box's helper, which serves a session container's files and processes to the host from inside it; fleet-tau's TypeScript runner, which type-checks and runs the model's programs there with ts-executor; and fleet's implementations of the APIs a tau declares, which those programs import as @api/<name>. Each part's protocol module is shared with the host

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
